description: This Java class 'SearchViewFilterMode' is an Android activity demonstrating the use of a SearchView to filter a ListView in-place. It initializes UI components, sets up search behaviour, and listens for query text changes to filter the list dynamically.

classes.name: SearchViewFilterMode
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating filtering a list with a SearchView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the layout, and configures the search and list view components.

methods.name: setupSearchView
methods.description: Configures the SearchView's behavior including default iconification, query listener, submit button, and hint.

methods.name: onQueryTextChange
methods.description: Handles changes in the search query to filter the list view accordingly.

methods.name: onQueryTextSubmit
methods.description: Handles the submit action of the search query; here returns false indicating no custom submission handling.
